summary: A message someone deletes or unsends in a chat is now forgotten by Nora too: she stops quoting it, and the notes, positions and events built on it stop being shown.
details: Before this, an unsent message stayed visible to Nora in every transcript and in everything derived from it.
An operator command, `nora withdrawal reconcile-deletes`, applies the same to deletes that were already recorded.
limitations: Honcho, her long-term memory, has no way to delete one message, so something it already learned from a deleted message may remain there.
A deleted message stays hidden, and a note or position that rested on it stays withdrawn until it is written again.
Deleting one of Nora's own messages is only recognised on Signal.
